newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup seeks 3 foreign managers - paper.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup seeks 3 foreign managers - paper.

text.p: SAirGroup will ask the Swiss government to grant it special authorisation so three foreigners can join the executive management of the Swissair airline.

Philippe Bruggisser, chief executive of newly-created SAirGroup, told the Swiss Sunday paper Sonntags Blick the rules permit exceptions and he could not imagine the government would refuse an exception in light of the globalisation of business.
On March 11 SAiGroup announced that one U.S. citizen and two British citizens would join the management of Swissair.
However, Swiss aviation regulations state Swiss citizens must occupy at least two-thirds of Swissair's management board.
From January 1, 1998 SAirGroup's plan is that Swissair's executive management board will consist of six people, three Swiss and three non-Swiss.
SAirGroup's plan is that American Jeffrey Katz will take over as chief executive of Swissair on January 1, 1998. Katz comes to Swissair from American Airlines.
He would be joined on the executive board by two British citizens; Ray Lyons and Lee Shave, both joining Swissair from British Airways. ((-- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340))
